symbols.name: FixedArray
symbols.description: Declares a fixed-length array type for Specta exporters.

symbols.name: Remapper
symbols.description: Recursively replaces DataTypes within a DataType structure from a set of remap rules.

symbols.name: Remapper::dangerous_bigints_as_number
symbols.description: Remaps the BigInt-style integer primitives — i64, u64, i128, u128, isize and usize — so they export as a plain number instead of erroring or exporting as bigint. Signed types map to i32 and unsigned types to u32 — a fixed-width integer, so the result is a clean number rather than the number | null that f64 would produce.

symbols.name: Remapper::new
symbols.description: Creates a remapper with no rules.

symbols.name: Remapper::remap_dt
symbols.description: Applies the remap operation to a datatype, returning the remapped datatype.

symbols.name: Remapper::remap_types
symbols.description: Applies the remap operation to every datatype in a Types collection, returning the remapped collection.

symbols.name: Remapper::rule
symbols.description: Registers a rule that replaces exact matches of from with to.
symbols.signature: fn rule(self: Self, from: DataType, to: DataType) -> Self

symbols.name: selection
